# Version 4.151.0
> **Skia m151 performance release** · Released July 30, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.151.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.151.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.151.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 delivers the Skia m151 engine update with faster managed color, shaping, and pixel operations. It also improves WebAssembly support, fixes native resource lifetime issues, and adds zero-copy shaping results for text-heavy applications.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m151** — The bundled renderer advances to Chrome milestone 151 with subsequent upstream correction merges. ([#4294](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4294), [#4304](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4304))

## API Surface

- **SKShaper exposes zero-copy glyph results** — Text shaping can read glyph results through spans, avoiding unnecessary managed copies. ([#4408](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4408))

## Bug Fixes

- **Encoded-data subset resources are released** — SKImage creation from encoded data with a subset no longer leaks its native resource. ([#4389](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4389))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Common color operations run in managed code** — Color conversion, premultiplication, tag parsing, and hex parsing avoid recurring interop and allocation overhead. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#4340](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4340), [#4376](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4376), [#4459](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4459))

## Platform

- **WebAssembly exception handling updated** — WASM native libraries and validation are updated for current .NET preview exception-handling support. ([#4411](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4411), [#4415](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4415))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1

HarfBuzzSharp improves UTF-8 input handling, tag parsing, and zero-copy shaped-glyph access.
